verdict.rationale: Bolt documents ways to start a project without a blank prompt: importing an existing GitHub repository, importing a Lovable project, or building from Figma or Google Stitch designs. That lets a founder begin from an existing (possibly community) codebase. However, the start-project docs list only a blank prompt, file uploads, and design imports, with no template gallery or community project hub, so the core template/community part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented template library, a community project gallery or remix/fork flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt

citations.quote: Import a GitHub repository. Load an existing repository as a Bolt project.
Anyone can start from a blank prompt, upload files to build with, or import designs from Figma or Google Stitch.
Import from Lovable. Bring a Lovable project into Bolt.
